title: IncomingCall
summary: An incoming call is reported to CallKit, and the system draws the ringing screen, on the lock screen too. Monarch ships no ringing banner.
whenToUse: Whenever the app receives a call. A VoIP push must be reported to CallKit in the PushKit callback, or the system ends the app.
whenNotToUse: Do not draw a custom ringing screen. For a message that is not a call, use a notification.
api: func reportNewIncomingCall(with UUID: UUID, update: CXCallUpdate, completion: @escaping ((any Error)?) -> Void)

states.name: ringing
states.description: The system screen or banner with the caller name from CXCallUpdate, and Accept and Decline.

states.name: answered
states.description: The provider delegate receives CXAnswerCallAction; the app connects the call and shows its call screen.

states.name: declined or missed
states.description: The delegate receives CXEndCallAction, or the app reports the end with reportCall(with:endedAt:reason:).

appearance: System appearance in every theme. Monarch has no part in it; the app can set the icon and ringtone in CXProviderConfiguration.
platformNotes: The web IncomingCall is a banner with Decline and Answer that the product places and rings itself. Android uses a full-screen notification with CallStyle. On iOS a custom banner cannot ring on the lock screen and a VoIP push must be reported to CallKit, so the system screen is the only answer. "Answer with audio only" for a video call has no counterpart on the system screen; set hasVideo on the CXCallUpdate.
accessibility: System behaviour: the ringing screen is accessible, announces the caller and works with hearing devices and CarPlay.
edgeCases: CXProvider is not available on macOS; guard the code with #if os(iOS).
Keep one CXProvider for the lifetime of the app and set its delegate; without a delegate an answered call connects nothing.
CallKit is not available in every region; check before using it.
The example and the catalogue page were compiled but the ringing screen was not run.

examples.title: Audio call

parityExceptions.reason: The system call screen belongs to CallKit, which shows the caller name and the answer and decline controls; the card is the in-app banner a product draws while the app is open, with the same avatar, caller, status, detail and round buttons as the web.
